doc.title: Percy Humphrey Band: Percy Humphrey, Jim Robinson, Ernest Roubleau, Josiah Frazier Interview, 1972-02-29

title: Disneyland finale with Louis Armstrong and the key of D flat
summary: Percy and Jim recall the Disneyland river parade with five bands and five trumpets, and a difficult key.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
